approx_location_count: More than 90 locations across 20+ U.S. states, plus the UAE
franchise_corporate_mix: Franchise system. The new CEO is a former multiunit franchisee and sits on the franchising board. The company is preparing to open 20 new locations.
current_online_ordering_provider: First-party order app at ordernow.hangryjoes.com. The app's public config is registered to Incentivio (Mapbox username incentivioeng).
signal: Named Brandon Wilhelm CEO, effective immediately. His priorities include franchisee profitability, marketing investment, and opening 20 new locations.
why_now: A new CEO who just promised franchisees better marketing and systems, with 20 openings ahead, is a natural moment to look at first-party ordering.

approx_location_count: More than 150 U.S. restaurants, of more than 400 worldwide
franchise_corporate_mix: Has franchise partners in the U.S. The exact corporate vs franchise split was not stated in the announcement.
current_online_ordering_provider: order.campero.com. The order site loads assets from koala-web-ordering-themes.s3.amazonaws.com (Koala web ordering). It does not load Olo assets.
signal: Named Julio Sanchez CEO of the U.S. business, effective immediately, as the brand grows past 150 U.S. restaurants. Outgoing COO Luis Javier Rodas concluded nearly 26 years with CMI on Oct. 16.
why_now: A new U.S. CEO is being asked to raise same-store sales and the guest experience, and the current order site is not on Olo.

approx_location_count: Nearly 20 sports-entertainment venues across 13 states and Washington, D.C. Location count grew by nearly 50% in 2025.
franchise_corporate_mix: The company says it operates the venues. No franchise mix was stated.
pos_if_public: Toast. The brand site links to tables.toasttab.com.
signal: Named Shannon McNiel sole CEO to lead national expansion. He had been co-CEO. Owner Brooks Schaden returned to SIF Partners and stayed on the board.
why_now: A newly sole CEO talking about national expansion, on Toast today, is a clean mid-market conversation about first-party ordering and guest data.

pos_if_public: Toast. The brand's online-orders page links to order.toasttab.com.
why_now: A new owner often standardizes ordering and POS across a 22-unit smashburger brand that is already on Toast.

franchise_corporate_mix: Not stated in the announcement. The brand has been backed by Freeman Spogli since 2017.
current_online_ordering_provider: First-party ordering at caferio.com/order (a Cafe Rio Next.js app). The public page source does not name Olo, Toast, ChowNow, or Thanx.
marketplace_footprint: Individual Cafe Rio restaurants also appear on Grubhub.
signal: Appointed Adam Klaers (from CAVA) as COO and promoted Julie Boyster to chief brand officer, with digital and IT now in her remit, after Mike Burns became CEO earlier in 2026.
why_now: A new COO plus a brand chief who now also owns digital and IT is the group that would review a first-party ordering and guest platform.

approx_location_count: Approaching 70 restaurants. Leadership said it plans to open six or seven restaurants in 2027, likely in Phoenix and California.
signal: Amy Hom joined as COO (from Barcelona Wine Bar), the second major executive change in a year after CEO Josh Kern arrived in October 2025. Leadership is focused on waitlist and operations as it returns to growth.
why_now: A new COO at a brunch brand that is adding units and trying to fix long waits is a good moment to talk about first-party ordering and guest flow.

approx_location_count: More than 1,800 locations worldwide. The company has a goal of 1,000 U.S. locations by 2030. The current U.S. count was not stated in the announcement.
franchise_corporate_mix: The CEO of CJ Foodville USA cited franchise owners and franchise partners in the announcement.
marketplace_footprint: The U.S. site (tljus.com) links to order.online, DoorDash's ordering domain.
signal: Appointed Max Gallegos, a longtime McDonald's marketer, as chief marketing officer for North America, overseeing brand, digital, loyalty, and field marketing during a U.S. expansion push. A new Powell, Ohio cafe opened on Nov. 16, 2026.
why_now: A new CMO owns digital and loyalty just as the brand is trying to scale U.S. franchising toward 1,000 cafes.

approx_location_count: 5,969 U.S. restaurants at year-end 2025. Further closures have been reported in 2026; a later official total was not confirmed here.
current_online_ordering_provider: First-party ordering at order.wendys.com. The public homepage also points to DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Grubhub.
marketplace_footprint: DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Grubhub are linked from wendys.com.
signal: Activist investors including Trian Fund and Flynn Group proposed a roughly $1.4 billion buyout. Separately, on Aug. 24, 2026, Wendy's named Tariq Hassan to the new role of chief marketing and customer growth officer.
why_now: A possible ownership change plus a new marketing and customer-growth chief is a window to talk about first-party ordering and marketplace mix, even if this is a large, competitive account.

approx_location_count: Large franchised U.S. system. An amended franchise disclosure document showed 275 franchised U.S. restaurants closed in 2026 through Aug. 18. A precise remaining count was not confirmed here.
franchise_corporate_mix: Heavily franchised. The 275 closures through Aug. 18 were all franchised locations. LongRange bought the chain (excluding China) from Yum Brands.
signal: LongRange Capital closed its purchase of Pizza Hut in early September 2026 (Yum agreed in June to sell it for $1.5 billion, excluding China). Pizza Hut sold $1 billion of whole-business securitization bonds on Nov. 16, 2026, to help fund the buyout, with closing expected Nov. 20.
why_now: A new PE owner recapitalizing a giant franchise system is often when digital ordering and guest platforms get a fresh look.

approx_location_count: Exact current system size was not confirmed here. The company sold 108 company-owned restaurants in 2026 for about $89.4 million and expects to close eight more (116 total) by the end of fiscal 2026.
franchise_corporate_mix: Shifting toward franchise. The company completed most of the 108-unit refranchising by Sept. 1, 2026, and refinanced on Oct. 2. Coverage on Nov. 23 said nearly half of locations will soon be franchisee-owned.
current_online_ordering_provider: First-party ordering at order.redrobin.com. The public page source does not name Olo, Toast, ChowNow, or Thanx.
signal: Completed most of three refranchising deals (108 restaurants) and, on Oct. 2, refinanced with a new $115 million credit facility to support its First Choice Plan.
why_now: A brand moving quickly from company-owned to franchise needs clean brand and location hierarchy, and a consistent digital ordering setup for new franchisees.

approx_location_count: Smaller than before the 2024 bankruptcy. Additional restaurants closed during 2026 right-sizing. A precise remaining count was not confirmed here.
current_online_ordering_provider: Existing Olo customer. In June 2025 Red Lobster announced it was returning to Olo, including first-party catering, after a homegrown system proved too costly.
signal: Named Andy Pitts chief marketing officer (he had been interim since January 2026, including the Red Lobster Nation loyalty launch) and promoted Jon Tryzbiak to chief information officer, with a mandate to modernize restaurant systems, data, and AI.
why_now: A new CMO and CIO at a brand already back on Olo is an upsell conversation about Engage, catering, or guest data, not a new logo.

approx_location_count: Regional brand concentrated in Florida. A third-party location dataset (CREHQ) listed 122 active U.S. locations as of Nov. 21, 2026.
franchise_corporate_mix: Owned by Authentic Restaurant Brands, which also owns Primanti Bros, Tavern in the Square, P.J. Whelihan's, and Mambo Seafood.
current_online_ordering_provider: Existing Olo customer. order.pollotropical.com loads serve-next.olo.com and static.olocdn.net.
signal: Parent Authentic Restaurant Brands secured a $325 million investment package from Trimontium to fund expansion of its 'hometown hero' brands.
why_now: New capital at a parent that already has at least two brands on Olo is an expansion or upsell conversation across the ARB portfolio.

franchise_corporate_mix: Part of Authentic Restaurant Brands, the same parent as Pollo Tropical.
current_online_ordering_provider: Existing Olo customer. order.primantibros.com loads serve-next.olo.com and static.olocdn.net.
signal: Same parent-company signal as Pollo Tropical: Authentic Restaurant Brands' $325 million Trimontium investment, announced Sept. 11, 2026.
why_now: If Olo already serves Primanti Bros and Pollo Tropical, the new ARB capital is a reason to check the rest of the portfolio and any unused Olo products.

approx_location_count: More than 150 U.S. locations, and about 500 worldwide, around the time of the deal.
franchise_corporate_mix: Franchise brand. Serruya Private Equity took the Americas business. Minor Food was the other buyer in the global transaction.
current_online_ordering_provider: Existing Olo customer. order.bonchon.com loads serve-next.olo.com and static.olocdn.net.
signal: Acquisition by Minor Food and Serruya Private Equity closed Sept. 1, 2026. The deal had been announced in mid-August. Serruya holds the Americas operations.
why_now: A new PE owner of the U.S. business, on a brand already ordering through Olo, is an upsell or expansion conversation, not a new logo.

approx_location_count: 97 domestic locations as of Dine Brands' second-quarter 2026 report (cited Oct. 29, 2026).
franchise_corporate_mix: Part of Dine Brands Global, alongside Applebee's (1,557 restaurants worldwide in that same quarter) and IHOP (1,813 worldwide).
current_online_ordering_provider: Existing Olo customer. fuzzystacoshop.olo.com and fuzzyscatering.olo.com are linked from fuzzystacoshop.com.
signal: Dine Brands received a reported $39/share unsolicited buyout offer from Cobblers Cove Capital and Arkhouse Management, then adopted a poison pill. Coverage later said Dine rejected the offer.
why_now: Ownership noise at Dine, plus a sister brand already on Olo, is a reason to map Applebee's and IHOP separately rather than assume the whole company is a new logo.
